correctness.rationale: The elementary constant-coordinate cases are valid. For a nonconstant algebraic germ with both x and z nonconstant, x and z have transcendence degree at most one over C, the defining equation puts exp(x) in C(x,z,wp(z)), and wp'(z) is algebraic over wp(z), so the relevant graph field has transcendence degree at most two. The semi-abelian Ax-Schanuel theorem for A=G_m x E0 gives the conflicting lower bound at least three once the germ is not contained in a proper algebraic subgroup; Hom(G_m,E0)=0 and both coordinates nonconstant exclude the product proper subgroups. The range scripts are not needed for this algebraic contradiction beyond keeping the analytic branch regular.
residual_risks: The RESULT cites Gao as part of the black-box chain even though Gao 1806.01408 is about universal abelian varieties/Kuga type; Ax/Noguchi is the cleaner semi-abelian source. The exact formal/analytic localization from an algebraic germ to the theorem is standard but not reproved in the package.
